svg.title: Her books by the forms named on them
svg.desc: Bar chart: the 49 entries of the Nobel Committee's bibliography (a selection) by the form their own line or the Committee's essay names, from the classical-dialogue tag (16) to scholarly thesis (1); solid parts named on the line, hatched parts only in the Committee's essay; 12 entries name no form. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
